description: What one unit of a given task costs in a given market — the human cost per unit, the AI cost per unit, and the ratio between them, with the source behind every figure. Markets: `us` (United States), `gr` (Greece), `ua` (Ukraine). Note that `uk` means Ukraine in this dataset, not the United Kingdom.

taskId.description: Task id from `list_work_tasks`. One of: invoice-entry, lead-callback, appointment-rescue, review-reply, receivables-chase, returns-case, cod-confirmation, customer-winback, supplier-price-check, quote-build, shift-schedule, candidate-screening, service-followup.
